"Create a grotesque 3D fashion competition game called \"RAT COUTURE – THE FILTHY RUNWAY\".

VISUAL STYLE AND ATMOSPHERE

The entire game must use a highly detailed, grotesque, dirty and disturbing 3D visual style.

Art direction:

- Photorealistic, highly detailed 3D characters.
- Anthropomorphic rat humans with human bodies and grotesque rat faces.
- Dirty, greasy, unkempt fur.
- Unusual body proportions, deformities, scars, pimples, warts and crooked teeth.
- Dark underground punk fashion aesthetics.
- Filthy industrial environments, rusty metal, stained concrete and flickering neon lights.
- Extreme fashion photography lighting.
- Absurd, provocative, surreal and darkly humorous atmosphere.

IMPORTANT DESIGN RULES

This must NOT look cute, cartoonish, childish or like a standard mobile dress-up game.

The characters should look bizarre, uncomfortable, ugly, expressive and visually memorable.

Clothing and accessories must have realistic 3D materials, textures, physics and lighting.

The game should feel like an underground fashion competition from a bizarre dystopian world.

GAME STRUCTURE

The player competes against four AI-controlled rat humans.

Each competition round:

1. The jury announces a fashion theme.
2. Five random clothing or accessory categories are selected.
3. Each category offers ten different items.
4. The player selects exactly one item from each category.
5. Four AI opponents independently create outfits.
6. All five contestants walk the runway.
7. The jury evaluates their outfits and awards points.

Build the game with a modular structure so new categories, items, themes, characters and jury personalities can be added later.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
